svg.aria-label: A monolith versus microservices. A monolith is one deployable application containing all modules, such as users, orders and payments, sharing one database; calls between modules are in-process function calls and transactions are easy. Microservices split the modules into separately deployed services, each owning its own database, reached through an API gateway; teams deploy and scale independently, but calls go over the network and consistency across services needs sagas or events.
